PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss and Glycaemic Control Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and glycaemic control through resistance and aerobic training"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Low Intensity Cardio":

          walking 5m
